verdict.rationale: Notion provides a documented REST API with OpenAPI spec, developer docs, PATs, OAuth and webhooks, enabling developers to build integrations, and even has an MCP server for agentic tooling. However, none of the evidence explicitly names official client SDK libraries (e.g., language-specific SDKs) or shows independent developer confirmation of building against them. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK library documentation/naming, independent developer testimonials of SDK usage.
